body.value: Long back, there was a big woman and old man. The couple of the old woman and old man cultivated swidden field.
While having the swidden field cultivated, they had a daughter.
He (father) told her (daughter), "Child, watch out for the swidden fied. Watch out for sparrows. Drive away the sparrows."
He said, "Watch out for sparrows."He sent her to the usual swidden field."
Aftger that, the daughter went up to the swidden field.
When she went up on the swidden field, there was a giant monkey.

She sang, "O brother in law monkey, come, come, come! O giant lonely monkey, come, come, come! Come, come, come, ripe Mongya fruit fell off! Come, come, come, the cucumber is white like thighs! Cover the green fruits to ripen! Eat the ripe fruits! Come, come, come, on the hill top and hill bottom!
When she told that (to the monkey), the giant monkey brought cucumbers and mongya fruits. They two ate those.
After they had had eaten (those), when he (the giant monkey) undressed/took off all her bottom and top, they copulated.
When they copulated, the monkey also tore all the rest of the top and bottom.
He tore off all the remaining lungi, top and loin clothes completely.
After that, she went back home.
She (mother) said in surprise, "Hey child, why is all your top and lungi torn?" The mother told her. The mother asked her.

She said, "My mother, there is no one but you who can give life and death! I drove away sparrows and kites. I drove away the sparrow on the way. I drove away monkeys and wild pigs on the way. A large bamboo and horn tore (my clothes) on the way. The split bamboo in the bamboo bush scratched (my clothes). The thorns took away (my clothes).
She (mother) said, "It is almost bad." After giving her new blouse and lungi, she sent her back to the swidden field again.
When she sent her back to the swiddem field again, she sang as usual like that.
"Brother in law monkey, come, come! Giant monkey, come, come, come!" sang she as usual that way. Then, the gian monkey came.
When he came, he tore the new ones. He tore the noew ones too. He tore the new ones too.
Aftger that, when she went (to village), what usual thing she told was, "The bamboo n=bush took away the clothes."
She said, "The thornes took away(the clothes)."
He rmother bought her new clothes. She (daughter) took the new one.
After she (daughter) did like that thrice, fourth, her mother said, "Child, you, stay today."
She (mother) said, "I will go. I will go to the swidden field. You, stay home first. You are tired."
She (mother) said, "Stay home first. I will go."
She (mother) wore dresses like her daughter. After her mother wore dresses, after she had a turban, she went (to the swidden field).
When she (mother) went (there to the swidden field), the mother had sung herself.

"Brother in law, monkey, come, come, come! Lonely monkey, come, come, come! The cucumbers are white like thigh, come, come, come! Cover the green fruits to ripen." sang the mother. When she said, " Eat and eat! Cover the hill top and hill bottom to ripen the fruits.", the lonely giant lonely monkey king had come.

When he came, after he snatched the lungi of that of the daughter in usual way. He tore the tops., he copulated with that daughter. When he copulated, after the mother took a knife quickly, she stabbed the monkey king with the knife. She killed him.
Having had the monkey dead, she buried his head under a tree.
Then, she dried all its intestine on dry tree branch in sun.
She dried all of its intestine in sunlight.
She dried all of its intestine on the branch of the dry tree in sun. She buried its head under the tree.
Then, she put his penis on the roof supporting bamboo log, above the half split bamboo.
Having had his penis that way, she went back, the mother.
Having gone back, she (mother) said, "Daughter, go to the swidden field today. Guard (the swidden field) today."
After she (mother) told her that, she (daughter) went again (to the swidden field).
She was also very sad that day. Her eyelid shook. Her earlobe shook. Yes, she was very sad.
She went with a heavy heart.

After she went (to the swidden field), the daughter sang agian. She sang, "Giant lonely monkey, come, come, come! The cucumbers are white like thighs, come, come, come! The ripe Mongkya fruits fell off, come, come, come! Cover the green fruits to ripen. Cover the hill top and hill bottom to ripen the (frutis), giant lonely monkey!"
Even after she sang, he (monkey) did not come anymore. He (monkey) did not come anymore.
When he (monkey) did not come, she thought, "Uh! What happened to the giant lonely monkey? It is not good that he did not come anymore."
Having her heart sad, she thought, "Mother sowed all the turmeric heads and trunks there under the tree." She thought, "I will check myself first."
When she dug below the tree, she exactly saw the head of the monkey instead.
She thought, "I dried all the Khukhnu fruits above the tree branch. When she though "I look myself.", she saw exactly all his intestine instead.
Then, she (the daughter) thought, "She (mother) said, "I have kept cigarettes on the roof supporting bamboo log."" When she looked there she saw his (monkey's) penis, which was short, instead."
That is why, when she (daughter) choked due to weeping, the daughter died suddenly.
So, on that day and on that night, those two died.
From long back, they compare with people while talking about the place of cultivation that way.
When they talk in reference to the  place of comparing people, they fall in love with the monkey that way.
They fell in love with the forest monkey.

I told (the story) how it remains in the original version. So, this is what I only remembered, I only saw and I only told. Even when there is a mistake, when there is a mistake in the story, please forgive me. I pray for you. Thank you. This is it!
